narrative.details:
I see that the inner fire has dwindled. Would you say the spiritual euphoria lasted an hour?

If it's more of the gizzard gum you desire, then more of the gizzards I require. Back to the wastelands, adventurer. Do not return until you have recovered ten gizzards and two jowls.
narrative.objectives: Bring ten Vulture Gizzards and two Snickerfang Jowls to Bloodmage Lynnore.
narrative.offerRewardText: Perhaps one day I shall be able to isolate the active enzymes of this assay and produce a much more efficient resultant. Unfortunately, you will have to settle for what I am currently able to produce. Return to me should you require more gizzard gum.
narrative.requestItemsText: Do not waste my time, adventurer. We have nothing to discuss, unless you have recovered the items I have requested.
